# Honest Vacation Marketing

> Vacation certificate offers with every cost printed before you give your name.
> A brand of Elite Marketing Solutions LLC, Santa Barbara CA.

## What this is
Four vacation certificate offers provided by Gateways Unlimited and fulfilled by
Customer Service Network Group (CSNG). To receive a certificate you attend one live 45-60 minute online
presentation. There is no charge to attend and you keep the certificate either way.

## Who qualifies
A couple attending together, both aged 35-72, household income over $75,000,
holding a major credit card, and who have not attended a vacation-ownership
presentation in the last 90 days.

## The offers
- **Cruise Getaway for Two** ($290–$314 out the door for two) — Sail 3, 4 or 5 nights from a port near you. Interior stateroom for two, ongoing member travel benefits after. https://honestvacationmarketing.com/cruise.html
- **All-Inclusive Beach Escape** ($390–$538 out the door for two) — Cancún, Dominican Republic or Montego Bay. Meals and drinks genuinely included — we print what "included" means. https://honestvacationmarketing.com/all-inclusive.html
- **Resort Stay + Airfare Credit** (~$300 out the door for two) — Cabo, Costa Rica, Honolulu, San Juan or Cancún — resort accommodations plus a $500 airfare credit in one plan. https://honestvacationmarketing.com/resort-air.html
- **Full Condo Week** (from $210 out the door for two) — A whole week with a kitchen and room to spread out. 60+ destinations across the US, Canada, Caribbean and Mexico. https://honestvacationmarketing.com/condo.html

## The operating rule
Everything upfront, everything optional. Every offer page prints its taxes, fees,
refundable deposit and the sourced market price being beaten, above the signup form,
along with every restriction. Prices researched August 4, 2026.
